Manip Shuurga is a half-orc wizard and an officer of the Flaming Fist. She can be encountered in the Mind Flayer Colony in Act Two.
“
Hurr, what a stench. I'm beginning to think I should have stayed in that pod. In there it only smelled like me.
„
— Shuurga, after being freed from the pod

Involvement

Act Two

In the end of the Act Two, Shuurga can be found in the Mind Flayer Colony, imprisoned in a pod within the Tadpoling Centre. Upon interacting with the Neural Apparatus controlling the pods, it is revealed that Shuurga has been captured and consigned to the future transformation, but is still not tadpoled (as well as  Zevlor and  Gauntlet Yeva in other pods around the room).

Choosing to release Shuurga and other pod captives immediately leads to a battle with several victims already transformed into  Mind Flayers and all  Intellect Devourers that spot the fight. Provided she survives, Shuurga expresses the strongest concern about  Duke Ravengard, whom she obviously came here to rescue. Afterwards, she presumably escapes the colony with Zevlor and Yeva, and is never met again throughout the game (as well as anywhere before exploring the colony).

Shuurga is presumably the Manip that  Counsellor Florrick ordered Gauntlet Yeva to report to for reinforcements in order to rescue Ravengard. The only other plausible alternative is  Manip Vidor, who remains at Florrick's side throughout her presence in Shadow-Cursed Lands.

Notes

  1. ↑ Shuurga has none of the racial features that come with being a half-orc. Also, her portrait is special in how it has a unique pose that is not found in any other half-orc portrait in the game.
  2. ↑ Despite being a wizard, having a caster archetype, and eight level's worth of spell slots, Shuurga has no spells or cantrips to cast and thus is forced to fight with melee. She also is mechanically naked and wears no armour; the Flaming Fist chain mail that she wears is purely cosmetic.
